metadata.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026. Centerline digitization by OpenRacetrackDB.
notes: The operator separates the 2 km Wind circuit from the 600 m Thunder hairpin and the 1.1 km Fire sector. Its Wind identification retains the long main straight, short northeastern closing turn, long northern straight, western rounded return and short western closing connector. The full southwest Thunder hairpin, southeastern Fire loops and pit route are excluded. The operator zone graphic and oblique aerial photograph identify branches only; neither is georeferenced, digitized or redistributed. All coordinates are independently selected from pinned native 21 September 2026 public Sentinel bands. The 3 June red, green, blue and near-infrared bands corroborate the paved western return and short connector. The partial public course way 1323087236 independently corroborates that connector corridor but does not supply this recipe's coordinates. Native 10 m samples use nearest-neighbor reprojection and contrast stretching with no added spatial detail. Fine corner radii, the narrow connector centerline, travel direction and historical equivalence remain draft. The source trace is not scaled to an advertised or supplied distance. No supplied diagram pixels or private course coordinates are imported. Intermediate vertices along the two long straights retain the same observed lines and add no corner detail. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2024.4 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 66 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
